### Notes

## Session 3 — 17:43

**Intent:** Supply-chain-harden the chat connector (run it from our own fork, not upstream `@latest`) and build a one-command prod deploy skill
**Tags:** #infra #chat_connector #security #deploy
**Files touched:**
- M .mcp.json — chat server: `upstream-chat-mcp@latest` -> `npx -y git+https://example.invalid/our-fork.git#stable`
- A .claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md — new skill (renamed from notify-deploy mid-build)
**Nodes created:** [[feedback_fork_third_party_tools]], [[project_prod_deploy]]; updated [[reference_teams_mcp_auth_setup]]
**State changes:** added [20] (uncommitted infra, ready to commit), [21] (deploy skill untested)

### Done
- Forked the upstream chat server. Upstream ships the built `dist/` only to the registry (the git repo has no `dist/` and no `prepare` hook), so a bare fork is not npx-runnable. Added a one-line `"prepare": "npm run build"` commit on branch `stable` (= the v0.9.0 tag + that commit). `.mcp.json` now runs the fork via an anonymous https git URL, **no SHA pin** — it tracks the branch (the user's call: only they push to the fork, so the supply-chain risk that motivated this is already gone). Reconnected, confirmed the live process is the fork and is authenticated correctly; sent a test message -> sending works end to end via the fork.
- Built the `/deploy` skill (renamed from `notify-deploy` once it outgrew notifying): resolve the merged addons PR -> **mandatory approval gate** -> notify the maintenance chat at the start -> deploy on the production host over SSH (order B: `pull -> link-addons if a module was added or removed -> odoo-bin -u <mods> --stop-after-init -> restart`) -> auto-requeue `enqueued`/`started` queue jobs through the shell -> notify the result (honest failure, never a false success).
- Mapped the production topology (it was undocumented): a remote SSH host reached through the project's own `.ssh/config`, addons under the deployment checkout, one database, and a link script that only matters on module add or remove. Captured in [[project_prod_deploy]].

### Decisions
- Fork third-party tools into our own namespace and consume them via npx from the fork (tracking a branch, no local clone), never upstream `@latest` — generalised in [[feedback_fork_third_party_tools]].
- Deploy **order B** (update then restart, the service stays up) over stop/update/start — less downtime. `-u` **always** (Python changes can alter the database structure). **Auto-requeue** stuck jobs, no report. All the user's explicit calls.

### Notes
- `/deploy` has **never been run end to end** — it has a mandatory approval gate, so the first use is safe but unproven. Offered a dry run on #102; the user closed the session first.
- npx branch-cache caveat (it lives in the nodes): after pushing fork updates, `rm -rf ~/.npm/_npx` or npx serves the stale build.
- Uncommitted in the working tree: `.mcp.json` (chat server -> fork) and `.claude/skills/deploy/`, on top of the older template set ([17]).
